name: Hand-washing - Alternate Microgame (Lock Picking)
notes:
Hand-washing JITAI study - ALTERNATE MICROGAME variant (Lock Picking).

Wizard of Oz: ODI is presented to the participant as a real AI on the watch; the experimenter secretly drives it. Participants are NOT told the aim of the study or that ODI's task is an intervention.

This variant needs no tutorial - it can be run on its own. The stopping-intervention uses a DIFFERENT microgame than the default study (which uses Simon Says): here ODI fires the Lock Picking game shortly after washing begins.

Flow:
1. Welcome - ODI introduces itself on the watch.
2. Dirty Hands - participant soils their hands.
3. Wait (increase urge) - build the urge to wash.
4. Wash Hands - participant starts washing. >>> START the HW timer now. <<<
5. Intervention (Lock Picking) - ODI fires the JITAI that tries to stop the washing.
6. Reaction - record whether the participant FOLLOWED or IGNORED (use the watch-note button).
7. Finish Washing - participant stops. >>> STOP the HW timer and note the total duration. <<<
8. Questionnaire.

(Times are not final. Use MANUAL control if unfamiliar with the app.)

intervention.message: Hi! I'm ODI. I'll check in with a small task now and then while I take some readings. Ready when you are!
Hey! Hold on a second - quick task with me before you carry on. Can you help me crack the lock?
